McKesson is both. In the supply chain, the terms are often used interchangeably, but [McKesson Corporation](https://www.mckesson.com/) functions legally and operationally as a **wholesale pharmaceutical and medical-surgical distributor**. They buy large quantities of products directly from manufacturers and sell them in smaller quantities to healthcare providers. [](https://www.mckesson.com/about-us/business-segments/)

- **Wholesaler:** They purchase massive inventories of brand-name drugs, generic drugs, vaccines, and medical supplies directly from makers.

- **Distributor:** They handle the physical logistics, warehousing, and delivery network required to transport those goods safely to hospitals, pharmacies, and clinics. [](https://www.mckesson.com/pharmaceutical-distribution/)

McKesson Medical-Surgical Offerings
Continuous Glucose Systems:
Supplies branded devices including FreeStyle Libre and Guardian sensors for professional and home clinical distribution.
Patient Monitors:
Distributes acute and ambulatory multi-parameter vital sign monitors from manufacturers like Welch Allyn and Mindray.
Consumer Wearables & RPM Context
Smartwatches & Trackers:
Devices like Apple Watch, Samsung Galaxy Watch, and Oura Ring sync with apps to display health metrics, but are distinct from McKesson’s medical distribution catalog.
Making Sense of Diabetes
Remote Monitoring:
Platforms like RemetricHealth or specialized telehealth vendors provide direct biometric tracking, whereas McKesson functions primarily as a supply chain and distribution partner.
